repair_class: missing frozen before-internal-holds cash commitment deduction, no threshold tuning

cash_input.canonical: tradeable cash net of cash obligations already recognized by the supplying account, BEFORE the internal pending-buy commitments enumerated in this snapshot
cash_input.producer_rule: supply this basis explicitly; product display/broker free cash already net of the same internal holds is a different basis and must not be passed then deducted again
cash_input.recognized_payables: already reflected in supplied economic equity and canonical cash; never blindly subtract snapshot.recognized_payables a second time
cash_input.unrecognized_fee: charge pending unrecognized fee upper bound once to new cash capacity; fee_already_recognized=true requires cash already net of that recognized obligation
cash_input.adoption: versioned input basis binds only explicit synthetic preparation here; real producer-to-snapshot mapping and actual facts remain A04/A06 pending

pending_cash_commitment: sum(unique pending.remaining_quantity * pending.price_bound + pending.unrecognized_fee_upper_bound when not fee_already_recognized)
principal_price: price_bound for cash, max(mark,price_bound) for exposure; keep their purposes distinct
quantity: largest legal lot satisfying existing target/bucket/expert/risk/fee tests and residual cash capacity
membership: pending list contains other unsubmitted reservations, potentially fillable remaining buys and filled-but-unreported cash commitments once each; source adapter deduplicates by canonical reservation/fill relationship, dataclass rejects duplicate reservation IDs
terminal: cancellation/terminal report releases only confirmed unfilled quantity; missing confirmed fills and their fees retain commitment
unknown: missing finite price/fee/required cash basis blocks dependent new risk; no inference of zero
public_entry: decide_entry on cash failure must preserve exact FundingState and emit no transfers/holds/entry receipt; accepted replay keeps original quantities/results/postings and existing two-cycle invariant
regressions: cash-goldens.v1.json plus public entry/replay and original21goldens/three stories; no original frozen oracle edit
